articles.image_title: BERLIN, GERMANY - SEPTEMBER 22: German Chancellor and leader of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) Friedrich Merz (C) arrives for a meeting of the CDU and Christian Social Union (CSU) Bundestag faction at the Reichstag on September 22, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. Today's faction meeting is the first since the recent state elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. In Berlin the CDU lost to the leftist Die Linke. In Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania the CDU endured its worst state election result ever, failing to even have enough votes to remain in the state parliament. (Photo by Sean Gallup/Getty Images)
articles.author: Nikolaus Doll
